Context: 4. For Family Planning :

12. Differently-abled Central Government employees.Special Casual Leave not more than 10 days in a calendar year may be granted to attend Conferences/ Seminars/Training/Workshop related to Disability and Development-related programmes organized at National and State level agencies. Absence in excess of 10 days may be treated as regular leave due and admissible and it can also be combined with regular leave.  
- Appendix-Ill.
